_doc: Bundle products: a single storefront row that represents a batch
of figures sold together (e.g. the twelve Soul of Gold gold saints).
Items today are Tamashii item IDs only. The runner fetches each
page, aggregates names + release years into a free-text description,
and uploads one hero image per figure (capped at MAX_IMAGES_PER_BUNDLE).
Bundle slugs skip eBay + Fandom — group photo, final price, and
any narrative copy are added by hand in /admin/products/<id>.
